entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, I'm stuffed!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Pretty damn good, huh?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This one's on me. Don't expect it to happen[n]too often though.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Where's my wallet...?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Eh, whatever.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh by the way, I got a text from Takeishi...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: He said the track team's gonna try n' ditch[n]Yamauchi. They wanna start practicin'[n]without him.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: They're trying to get their old coach back[n]too... The one from before Kamoshida.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Looks like they're finally walkin' their[n]own path.
Are you satisfied now?[clr 27]
Not running?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hm... Yeah, I guess so.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? I mean, yeah they're prolly doin'[n]sprints or... Wait.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For a guy who wears glasses, you're pretty[n]damn dumb!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, and uh... they asked me to come back[n]to the team.
What did you say?
Do you have any time for that?
Don't do it.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I had to turn 'em down.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It felt kinda bad, but that's not where[n]I belong now.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hahaha, that was exactly what I was[n]thinkin'. I'm so busy with Phantom[n]Thieves stuff already.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It felt kinda bad, but that's not where[n]I belong now.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, I wasn't gonna.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It felt kinda bad, but that's not where[n]I belong now.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: When you first came to Shujin, people[n]were talkin' so much shit about you.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But you took it in stride.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You just did whatever you thought was[n]cool, and didn't care what other people[n]said about you.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I think that's why people kinda get pulled[n]towards you, man.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wherever you decide to be, that's where[n]you belong.
You're right.[clr 27]
I never realized that.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: God, you're so freakin' cool.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Seriously?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Y'know... back before I met you, I kept[n]makin' excuses for why I couldn't fit in.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It was always 'cause of someone else.[n]Kamoshida, the track team... Hell,[n]I even blamed my dad.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I was such a freakin' loser...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But I've realized now... as long as I'm bein'[n]myself, I'll always have somewhere I can[n]fit in.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It ain't really the same place as before,[n]but it's damn good.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...I'm just glad I found it.
I agree.[clr 27]
Be more specific.
And where is this place?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Heh, don't worry, man. There's a place[n]here for you too.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Right next to me... or maybe ahead?[n]Something like that.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? All right, I'll give it to you straight!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: My place is right in the middle of our team,[n]next to you!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You should already know that, man!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh, I guess it's... next to you?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That makes your place next to me, huh.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Er, next to? Or maybe in front of me...?[n]Something like that.
I feel like my bond with Ryuji[n]is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I ain't gonna stop trainin' though. I've still[n]got a long way to go.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Someday, I'm gonna show you speed so[n]lightnin' fast, you're not even gonna be[n]able to see me.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait, but if you can't see me, am I really[n]showin' you anything...?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Eh, whatever.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I think we've been talking too long.[n]We're all outta monja...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wanna try grillin' some toothpicks?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's head home.
